= a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Soulrend''' is a [[skill gem]] that casts a [[spell]] [[projectile]] that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and [[piercing]] through those it [[hit]]s, and [[leech]]ing some of that [[damage]] as [[energy shield]]. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful [[chaos]] [[damage over time]] [[debuff]] to each enemy in an [[Area of effect|area]] around it. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Soulrend has two damage components: a hit-based projectile component, and a DOT-based component caused by the projectile to enemies around it. *'''Hit''': The Soulrend projectile when hits deals chaos damage, and leeches 4% of this damage as Energy Shield *'''Damage over Time''': The Soulrend projectile applies chaos damage over time to enemies around it over a short duration. This damage over time is also affected by modifiers to spell damage. [[Critical strike]]s have no effect on the damage over time inflicted by the debuff. *'''Projectile''': By default Soulrend fires 1 projectile. Modifiers to number of projectiles will increase this number. For example, Soulrend can be linked with [[Greater Multiple Projectiles Support]] for better clear, and the damage penalty only applies to the hit-based component, not the DOT component. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Chaos
